title: Shield Throw in Dark fantasy game
author: Sudden_Bite_4808
selftext:
Sharing the ricocheting Shield Throw ability I'm working on in Unreal Engine 5 for my dark fantasy action RPG, The Last God. While prototyping the combat and classless synergy systems, I used generative AI for placeholder illustration images on the website/ability cards.

Disclosure: There are AI placeholder illustration images on the website.

Game Website: [https://thelastgod.vercel.app/systems](https://thelastgod.vercel.app/systems)
